facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for DR Congo: KINIX, Kinshasa, GOMIX, Goma, and LUBIX, Lubumbashi.
The African IXP Association's undated list, retrieved 2026-11-09, places DR Congo's exchange points in more than one city: Kinshasa, Goma and Lubumbashi.
